dialogues.jp: 「あれ……？　ことりじゃないか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey..? Isn't that Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Hey..? Isn't that Kotori?"

dialogues.jp:
とある屋台に、ちょっとした行列が出来ている
のだが、その中にあの帽子が見えた。
dialogues.en: I saw a familiar hat in a queue for a food cart.
dialogues.text: I saw a familiar hat in a queue for a food cart.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、行ってみるか」
dialogues.en: "I'll go check it out."
dialogues.text: "I'll go check it out."

dialogues.jp: 「ことり？」
dialogues.en: "Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
俺の姿を認めると、ことりは相好を崩した。何
となく、人をホッとさせる笑みである。
dialogues.en:
Her face lit up upon recognizing me. Somehow, her smile is
so infectious.
dialogues.text:
Her face lit up upon recognizing me. Somehow, her smile is
so infectious.

dialogues.jp: 「何してんの？　買い食い？」
dialogues.en: "What's up? Buying something to eat?"
dialogues.text: "What's up? Buying something to eat?"

dialogues.jp:
行列の先の方を見るが、何を買っているのかま
では分からない。
dialogues.en:
The front of the line is too far from here to see exactly
what's being sold.
dialogues.text:
The front of the line is too far from here to see exactly
what's being sold.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい。お腹が空いたから、道草です」
dialogues.en: "Yes. My stomach was rumbling, and it was on the way, so..."
dialogues.text: "Yes. My stomach was rumbling, and it was on the way, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp:
風見学園では、ことりはちょっとした有名人だ。
いわゆる、“学園のアイドル”という奴。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's quite famous around Kazami Academy. A lot of people
call her the "School Idol".
dialogues.text:
Kotori's quite famous around Kazami Academy. A lot of people
call her the "School Idol".

dialogues.jp:
でも、買い食いをしている姿なんて、全然、普
通の女の子だった。
dialogues.en:
But just looking at her queueing up to buy food, she looks
like a perfectly normal girl.
dialogues.text:
But just looking at her queueing up to buy food, she looks
like a perfectly normal girl.

dialogues.jp: 「で、何？　ドネルケバブとか？」
dialogues.en: "What are you buying? Donel Kebabs?"
dialogues.text: "What are you buying? Donel Kebabs?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「な、何ですか？　それは」
dialogues.en: "W, what's that?"
dialogues.text: "W, what's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「知らん？　でっかい肉をさ、杭で突き刺して、
　ぐるぐる回しながら焼いて……」
dialogues.en:
"Never heard of it? It's like a big piece of meat with a
stick pierced through it, then spun around constantly over a
fire..."
dialogues.text:
"Never heard of it? It's like a big piece of meat with a
stick pierced through it, then spun around constantly over a
fire..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「んで、パンみたいな奴に、野菜と一緒に挟ん
　で食べるんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"...And it's usually eaten on a piece of bread, with
vegetables in between."
dialogues.text:
"...And it's usually eaten on a piece of bread, with
vegetables in between."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……そこまでボリュームのある物は、食べら
　れませんよ」
dialogues.en: "...I won't be able to eat something so filling now."
dialogues.text: "...I won't be able to eat something so filling now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「クレープなんです」
dialogues.en: "I'm ordering a crepe."
dialogues.text: "I'm ordering a crepe."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「最近、美味しいクレープ屋さんが出来たって、
　学園じゃ有名なんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Recently, a vendor selling delicious crepes has started
coming around this park. It's famous around the school."
dialogues.text:
"Recently, a vendor selling delicious crepes has started
coming around this park. It's famous around the school."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Ahhh..."
dialogues.text: "Ahhh..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君は、クレープ、好きですか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, do you like crepes?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, do you like crepes?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、嫌いじゃないけど」
dialogues.en: "Well, I don't hate them."
dialogues.text: "Well, I don't hate them."

dialogues.jp:
そんな事を喋っているうちに、ことりの番が回っ
てきた。
dialogues.en:
While talking about that, Kotori's turn at the vendor
quickly came up.
dialogues.text:
While talking about that, Kotori's turn at the vendor
quickly came up.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「アイスクレープを３つください」
dialogues.en: "3 ice crepes, please."
dialogues.text: "3 ice crepes, please."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい、朝倉君、どうぞ。私のおごりです」
dialogues.en: "Alright, Asakura-kun, please take one. The treat's on me."
dialogues.text: "Alright, Asakura-kun, please take one. The treat's on me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、悪い。さんきゅ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, thank you."
dialogues.text: "Ah, thank you."

dialogues.jp: ぺこっと頭を下げ、クレープを受け取る。
dialogues.en: With a quick bow, I take one of the crepes.
dialogues.text: With a quick bow, I take one of the crepes.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　誰かと来てたの？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Who else is coming here?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Who else is coming here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　誰かって？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Someone?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Someone?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だって、クレープ」
dialogues.en: "The extra crepe, I mean."
dialogues.text: "The extra crepe, I mean."

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、両手にひとつずつのクレープを持っ
ているのだ。
dialogues.en: Kotori was carrying a crepe in each hand.
dialogues.text: Kotori was carrying a crepe in each hand.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、これは、私が食べるんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I'd be eating both of these."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I'd be eating both of these."

dialogues.jp:
ドネルケバブのボリュームと変わらないじゃな
いか。
dialogues.en: That would be about as filling as a Donel Kebab.
dialogues.text: That would be about as filling as a Donel Kebab.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……太っちゃうでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "...You think this would make me fat?"
dialogues.text: "...You think this would make me fat?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、今さら心配されても」
dialogues.en: "No, just a little worried."
dialogues.text: "No, just a little worried."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それもそうですね」
dialogues.en: "Alright then!"
dialogues.text: "Alright then!"

dialogues.jp:
ベンチにふたりで並んで、クレープにかじりつ
く。
dialogues.en: We found a bench to sit on, and bit into our crepes.
dialogues.text: We found a bench to sit on, and bit into our crepes.

dialogues.jp: 「おお、割と美味いな」
dialogues.en: "Ohhh, delicious!"
dialogues.text: "Ohhh, delicious!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね〜」
dialogues.en: "Isn't it~"
dialogues.text: "Isn't it~"

dialogues.jp:
ぱくっと口を付けたクレープの向こうで、こと
りが目を細める。
dialogues.en:
The sweetness of the crepe filled my tastebuds, and I closed
my eyes in bliss.
dialogues.text:
The sweetness of the crepe filled my tastebuds, and I closed
my eyes in bliss.

dialogues.jp:
２月に食べるにはちょっと寒いが、味は悪くな
い。
dialogues.en:
Although it's a bit weird eating such a cold thing in
Feburary, it tastes just as good anytime.
dialogues.text:
Although it's a bit weird eating such a cold thing in
Feburary, it tastes just as good anytime.

dialogues.jp:
それに、空気は冷たいものの、日差しはそれな
りに温かいのだった。
dialogues.en:
Besides, even though the air is cold, the sun is still
shining, it's rays showering gently onto the earth.
dialogues.text:
Besides, even though the air is cold, the sun is still
shining, it's rays showering gently onto the earth.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、こういうのも食べるんだ？　前に、和
　菓子が好きだって言ってなかったっけ？」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't know you'd eat such a thing though. You've never
said before that you like sweets, have you?"
dialogues.text:
"I didn't know you'd eat such a thing though. You've never
said before that you like sweets, have you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「甘い物なら、だいたい好きなんです」
dialogues.en: "I like sweet stuff of all sorts."
dialogues.text: "I like sweet stuff of all sorts."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だから、いつだってダイエットが気になるん
　ですよね」
dialogues.en:
"That's why I'm always thinking of going on a diet, they're
so fattening..."
dialogues.text:
"That's why I'm always thinking of going on a diet, they're
so fattening..."

dialogues.jp: ことりの全身に、さらっと視線を走らせた。
dialogues.en: I do a quick once-over of her with my eyes.
dialogues.text: I do a quick once-over of her with my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「気にする必要なんて、ないと思うけど」
dialogues.en: "I don't think you have anything to be worried about."
dialogues.text: "I don't think you have anything to be worried about."

dialogues.jp:
服の上から見る限り、なかなか立派なプロポー
ションだと思った。
dialogues.en:
She pretty much has the perfect body, with perfect
proportions.
dialogues.text:
She pretty much has the perfect body, with perfect
proportions.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですかね……」
dialogues.en: "If you say so..."
dialogues.text: "If you say so..."

dialogues.jp:
赤い顔をして目を逸らすと、ごにょごにょと呟
いた。
dialogues.en:
She muttered, as her face turned red and she looked away in
embarassment.
dialogues.text:
She muttered, as her face turned red and she looked away in
embarassment.

dialogues.jp: 「……さて、ゴチになりやした、と」
dialogues.en: "...Whew, that was good."
dialogues.text: "...Whew, that was good."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わっ。早いですね〜」
dialogues.en: "Wow, you're a fast eater~"
dialogues.text: "Wow, you're a fast eater~"

dialogues.jp: 縁側の老人のように、ほのぼのと呟く。
dialogues.en: Said just like some old lady.
dialogues.text: Said just like some old lady.

dialogues.jp:
「……いや、ことりが遅いのでは？　……って
　か、垂れてるし。手」
dialogues.en:
"...Nah, more like you're a slow eater? ...Oh, the crepe's
fillings are oozing out..."
dialogues.text:
"...Nah, more like you're a slow eater? ...Oh, the crepe's
fillings are oozing out..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わわっ！」
dialogues.en: "Waah!"
dialogues.text: "Waah!"

dialogues.jp:
……垂れてるのに気づかないとは、ことりって
ずいぶん鈍いんだな。
dialogues.en:
...If she hadn't noticed the food dripping from her hand,
she'd have to be quite slow...
dialogues.text:
...If she hadn't noticed the food dripping from her hand,
she'd have to be quite slow...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんなことないですよ」
dialogues.en: "T, that's not true!"
dialogues.text: "T, that's not true!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いえ、こっちの話です」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I mean, what you said just now."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I mean, what you said just now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, right."
dialogues.text: "Oh, right."

dialogues.jp:
俺はことりがクレープを食べ終わるのを待つこ
とにした。
dialogues.en:
We were talking about Kotori being slow on finshing her
crepe, I nearly forgot.
dialogues.text:
We were talking about Kotori being slow on finshing her
crepe, I nearly forgot.

dialogues.jp: 「ゆっくり食べてていいからな」
dialogues.en: "Just eat it slowly and enjoy it."
dialogues.text: "Just eat it slowly and enjoy it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「礼ならいいぞ」
dialogues.en: "No need to thank me!"
dialogues.text: "No need to thank me!"

dialogues.jp: アイスクレープ、おごってもらったし。
dialogues.en: I've already been treated to an ice crepe anyway.
dialogues.text: I've already been treated to an ice crepe anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃなくて、あの……もう１個食べてくれま
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "No, I mean... do you think you can eat one more?"
dialogues.text: "No, I mean... do you think you can eat one more?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Seriously?"
dialogues.text: "...Seriously?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だって、このままじゃ……」
dialogues.en: "Well, at this rate..."
dialogues.text: "Well, at this rate..."

dialogues.jp:
早春の日差しは侮り難く、アイスは地中に伸び
ていく根っこのように垂れていく。
dialogues.en:
The sun's rays were quickly turning the ice crepe into
liquid crepe.
dialogues.text:
The sun's rays were quickly turning the ice crepe into
liquid crepe.

dialogues.jp: 「しゃーないな……」
dialogues.en: "Can't be helped..."
dialogues.text: "Can't be helped..."

dialogues.jp:
お腹の辺りをさすりつつ、ことりが食べていた
方を手に取った。
dialogues.en:
I tried to prepare my stomach somehow, and took one of the
crepes from Kotori.
dialogues.text:
I tried to prepare my stomach somehow, and took one of the
crepes from Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そっちは……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, this one..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, this one..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、丸々２個はさすがにキツイから」
dialogues.en: "...I won't be able to stomach more than two."
dialogues.text: "...I won't be able to stomach more than two."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それもそうですね」
dialogues.en: "I, I guess so..."
dialogues.text: "I, I guess so..."

dialogues.jp:
そんな訳で、がつがつとアイスクレープを消費
するふたりが居るのだった。
dialogues.en: With that, we continued eating the ice crepes together.
dialogues.text: With that, we continued eating the ice crepes together.

dialogues.jp: うう……寒いよお……。
dialogues.en: Ooh... so cold...
dialogues.text: Ooh... so cold...

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりとクレープ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori and crepes◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori and crepes◆

dialogues.jp:
桜公園で、ことりに出会った。彼女に、アイス
クレープをごちそうになってしまった。
dialogues.en:
I met Kotori at the Sakura Park, and she treated me to some
ice crepes.
dialogues.text:
I met Kotori at the Sakura Park, and she treated me to some
ice crepes.

dialogues.jp:
それは嬉しいのだが、冬にアイスは寒いよう
……。
dialogues.en: They were great, but such cold stuff in the winter...
dialogues.text: They were great, but such cold stuff in the winter...
